name: What maintenance is required for marble surfaces in a bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What maintenance is required for marble surfaces in a bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Marble requires regular maintenance to preserve its appearance and integrity. It is crucial to seal marble upon installation and then periodically, usually every 6-12 months, to protect against stains and etching. Clean spills immediately with a soft cloth. Use only pH-neutral cleaners specifically designed for natural stone; avoid acidic or abrasive cleaners, as they can damage the surface. Regular cleaning with a mild soap and water solution is generally sufficient for daily upkeep.
acceptedAnswer.description: Marble needs regular sealing, typically every 6-12 months, and immediate spill cleanup. Use pH-neutral stone cleaners and avoid acidic or abrasive products to prevent damage.
